name: Cid / ShortRef

test_list.description: Cid::to_hex then Cid::from_hex returns the same 32 bytes; hex is 64 lowercase chars.
ShortRef::of(&cid) holds exactly the first 6 bytes of the Cid.
ShortRef renders as 12 lowercase hex chars and `§ref:<12hex>` via to_marker().
from_hex rejects 63/65 chars and non-hex characters with ParseError, never panics.
ShortRef::from_str accepts `§ref:<12hex>` and bare 12 hex; rejects other lengths.
proptest: for any 32 bytes, Cid -> ShortRef -> hex -> parse is stable.
compile_fail doctest on FastFingerprint: there is no From/Into between FastFingerprint (xxh3, not collision resistant) and Cid.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: BLAKE3 digest (computed by polaris-storage-cas, not by sdk).

output_description: Validated content id and its 48-bit short reference used by §ref folding.
